name: Inverse Model Matrix Transformation for Distance Fields
definition: A technique to apply transformations (translation, rotation, scale) to distance field objects by transforming the sample point `p` using the inverse of the object's model matrix, rather than transforming the object geometry itself.
summary: Inverse Model Matrix Transformation for Distance Fields applies rigid transformations to Signed Distance Fields by evaluating the base distance function in local space using the inverse model matrix, avoiding geometry modification.
